mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (user_id, poem_id, favorite_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{poemId}, #{favoriteType})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND poem_id = #{poemId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.poem_id, p.title, pt.name AS poet_name, p.create_year, p.form, IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) FROM rating r WHERE r.poem_id = p.poem_id), 0) AS avg_score, f.favorite_type, f.favorite_time FROM favorite f JOIN poem p ON p.poem_id = f.poem_id JOIN poet pt ON pt.poet_id = p.poet_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.favorite_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
